objective: Prove the existing insurance architecture forms one coherent inbound lifecycle from public quote-request domain records through private presentation, triage, and governed operating-state transitions without adding production abstractions.

identity.rule: No identity translation or replacement is allowed across quote ingress, presentation, triage, or operating-state planning.

proofs: A canonical website quote request creates one lead in stage new with quote status requested.
The quote records create an InsuranceLeadPresentation with the same relationshipId.
The presentation enters both new and requested INS-006X triage cohorts.
A manual combined stage, quote-status, and producer transition preserves relationshipId.
A real stage transition creates one immutable stage-changed event for the same relationshipId.
The transitioned lead leaves the new cohort and enters the in-progress cohort.
A later quote-status-only transition preserves relationshipId and does not manufacture a stage event.
